name_zh: 马尔代夫/海平面上升/气候威胁/外交生存
description_zh: 马尔代夫作为全球最低海拔国家，面临海平面上升的生存威胁，通过外交、经济、技术手段应对气候变化，推动国际气候行动，寻求发展援助，探索可持续旅游模式，成为气候外交的先锋国家。
description_en: Maldives as the world's lowest-lying country faces existential threat from sea level rise, addresses climate change through diplomatic, economic, technical means, promotes international climate action, seeks development aid, explores sustainable tourism models, becoming pioneer country in climate diplomacy.
reason_zh: 马尔代夫气候生存外交代表小岛屿国家如何应对全球性挑战，展示了气候威胁如何重塑国际关系，其外交策略影响了全球气候治理，其经济发展模式影响了可持续旅游创新，其国际倡导影响了气候正义运动。
reason_en: Maldives climate survival diplomacy represents how small island states address global challenges, demonstrates how climate threats reshape international relations, its diplomatic strategy influences global climate governance, its economic development model influences sustainable tourism innovation, its international advocacy influences climate justice movement.
steps_zh: 研究马尔代夫地理脆弱性/气候风险/适应策略
分析国际外交努力/气候谈判/发展援助
探讨经济转型/可持续旅游/技术创新
评估区域合作/国际支持/未来挑战
总结气候外交/生存策略/国际影响/经验教训
steps_en: Study Maldives geographical vulnerability/climate risks/adaptation strategies
Analyze international diplomatic efforts/climate negotiations/development aid
Summarize climate diplomacy/survival strategies/international impact/lessons learned
expected_zh: 理解小岛屿国家如何应对全球性气候挑战，掌握气候生存外交的核心策略，评估国际气候合作的有效性，认识可持续发展在应对气候变化中的作用。
expected_en: Understand how small island states address global climate challenges, grasp core strategies of climate survival diplomacy, evaluate effectiveness of international climate cooperation, recognize sustainable development role in addressing climate change.
case_zh: 2009年水下内阁会议；2019年气候移民计划；2023年可再生能源目标。气候威胁/外交生存/国际合作/可持续发展。
case_en: 2009 Underwater Cabinet Meeting; 2019 Climate Migration Plan; 2023 Renewable Energy Goals. Climate threat/Diplomatic survival/International cooperation/Sustainable development.
cross_cultural_impact: Global climate policy/Small island states/Diplomatic innovation/Environmental advocacy/Regional cooperation
scientific_contribution: 是: 气候科学/海洋学
